stats: IMS' HA-35 "W-Wing" Short Range Heavy Assault Starfighter
Sensors 4D+2, SF piloting 5D+1, starship gunnery 5D+2, SS shields 3D

The HA-35 "W-Wing" Short Range Heavy Assault Starfighter was a very preliminary fighter design by the Rebel Alliance. It was stolen from the Echo Base computer during the capture of Hoth, and updated to Imperial technology. It now serves as a heavy bomber, and serves very well. The reborn Emperor used these in his failed campaign to destroy the Rebellion.

The Wraith hyperdrive is highly inefficient. As such the Hive must stop every 1D days to regenerate damages from traveling through hyperspace.

The ship's hull is regenerative. Use standard natural healing rules on page 98 of the Star Wars Core Rulebook 2nd Ed (Revised) for healing rates and rules. Use half of the ship's Hull code as the strength of the ship for the purposes of healing. A Very Difficult capital ship repair roll will double the healing speed.
